name: gaffer_execute_code
description: DANGEROUS: run Python in the attached Gaffer on its script (script, Gaffer, GafferScene, GafferImage, GafferDispatch, IECore, imath), given as code or as a script file (path). Assign a JSON-able dict to `result`; print() output is returned. A run that changes the script is one undo step; a failing one is undone, and a failure says what Gaffer knows (closest plug or class names, the plug a computation failed on, the expected value type). Every run asks permission.

path.description: A .py file to run instead of code, read as is (absolute or relative to the project): long scripts, no escaping.
